# interviewing.io

> Anonymous technical interview prep platform with AI interviewers, mock interviews from FAANG engineers, and data-driven hiring insights from 100k+ interviews.

interviewing.io provides comprehensive interview preparation for software engineers seeking roles at top tech companies, while offering employers a hiring channel powered by technical interview assessment. The platform combines practice interviews, company-specific guides, and real interview replays to help candidates and companies make better hiring decisions.

## Key Topics

- Technical Interview Preparation
- Mock Interviews
- FAANG Companies
- System Design
- Coding Interviews
- Interview Questions
- Senior Engineer Hiring
- Google Interviews

- Apple Interviews
- Netflix Interviews
- Interview Process
- Anonymous Practice

## Core Platform

- [Anonymous Coding & Technical Interview Prep for Software Engineers](https://interviewing.io): Main platform for anonymous technical interview prep with AI interviewer and coaching.
- [Mock Technical Interviews](https://interviewing.io/mocks): Free mock interview replays from Google, Meta, Amazon, Netflix engineers.
- [Topics](https://interviewing.io/topics): Interview prep guides and resources organized by company and topic.
- [Gift Interviews](https://interviewing.io/gift-practice-interviews): Gift card service for mock interview practice and interview preparation.

## Employer Hiring

- [Your best-converting channel for hiring engineers](https://interviewing.io/employers): Employer hiring platform leveraging technical interviews for candidate assessment.

- [Senior Engineer's Guide to Google Interviews + Questions](https://interviewing.io/guides/hiring-process/google): Insider guide to Google's interview process and hiring decisions.

- [Senior Engineer's Guide to Meta Interviews + Questions](https://interviewing.io/guides/hiring-process/meta-facebook): Meta interview process guide from current and former interviewers.
- [Senior Engineer's Guide to Apple Interviews + Questions](https://interviewing.io/guides/hiring-process/apple): Apple interview process and hiring guide from insider sources.
- [Senior Engineer's Guide to Microsoft Interviews + Questions](https://interviewing.io/guides/hiring-process/microsoft): Microsoft interview process and hiring guide for senior engineers.
- [Senior Engineer's Guide to Netflix Interviews + Questions](https://interviewing.io/guides/hiring-process/netflix): Netflix interview process and questions guide from interviewers.
